title: Temple TX Home Prices vs. Last Year: What's Really Happening?
description:
Thinking about buying or selling in Temple, TX? Here’s your September 2025 Market Update using the latest local stats (July 2025 report). Quick hits: Median price ≈ $276,000, months of inventory 6.8 (vs. 5.0 last year), active listings up 30.8% to 722, closed sales up 3.9% to 134, and days on market ~101. I’ll walk through what this means for pricing, negotiations, and timing this month. 

👉 BUYERS: More inventory = more leverage. We’re seeing longer DOM, better contingencies, and room for seller credits—especially in the $300K–$400K band where supply grew. I’ll show live examples and how to structure offers that win without overpaying. 

👉 SELLERS: With 6.8 months of inventory, positioning is everything. Price to the market, stage well, and use compelling video + targeted ads. I’ll share the three adjustments that shorten days on market right now and how we’re still getting full-price outcomes with strategic incentives.

📊 Data sources: Temple-Belton Board of REALTORS® monthly report (July 2025). Third-party portals put Temple’s mid-2025 medians in the $260K–$290K range depending on methodology—use local MLS-derived stats for decisions.
